entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
Welcome to Auckland University of Technology’s (AUT) Research Matters! 🚀 AUT’s Research Matters video series is where AUT academics answer everyday questions about their fields of expertise. Get the answer to those questions you’ve always had – or maybe never knew to ask.       

What does a physiotherapist actually do, and why is pain often more complicated than people think? Should you keep exercising when you're sore, is acupuncture worth trying, and what's the difference between acute and chronic pain? Lecturer David Toomey unpacks the science of pain, busts common myths, and shares practical advice on everything from recovery and stress to preventing long-term pain. 

00:00 Introduction
00:31 What exactly does a physiotherapist do?  
01:24 What’s the difference between acute pain and chronic pain?  
01:59 Should I avoid exercise if my muscles are sore?  
03:14 What kinds of treatments do you use to help people manage their pain?  
04:09 My physio wants me to try acupuncture, but I don’t understand how that works. Should I do it?  
05:15 How do you decide what kind of treatment someone needs?  
06:01 How does stress or anxiety affect pain?  
07:05 What’s one of the most surprising things people don’t know about pain?  
08:16 Are there things we can do every day to help prevent long-term pain?  
09:07 What’s one myth about pain you wish everyone would stop believing?  
10:21 How annoying is it when patients or clients don’t do their recommended recovery exercises?  
11:48 Is heat or an ice pack better to help ease pain?  
12:38 What’s the most common issue for physiotherapists to deal with? 

🎓 David Toomey’s academic profile - https://academics.aut.ac.nz/david.toomey  
Interested in studying physiotherapy at AUT? https://www.aut.ac.nz/research/academic-departments/physiotherapy  
What is chronic pain - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chronic_pain  
Exercising with sore muscles - https://www.rnz.co.nz/life/wellbeing/should-i-exercise-if-i-m-still-sore-from-last-time  
All about acupuncture - https://www.mayoclinic.org/tests-procedures/acupuncture/about/pac-20392763  
How stress can increase pain - https://www.uclahealth.org/news/article/stressed-out-it-could-be-contributing-to-your-pain  
Exercises that can help with chronic pain - https://www.healthline.com/health/exercises-to-reduce-chronic-pain  
Low back pain/Mamae ā-tuarā o raro - https://www.healthnz.govt.nz/health-topics/conditions-treatments/bones-and-joints/low-back-pain  
Ice packs or heat? https://www.health.harvard.edu/pain/cold-versus-heat-for-pain-relief-how-to-use-them-safely-and-effectively  
The Physiotherapy Board of NZ - https://physioboard.org.nz/
